commands.name: join
commands.description: Register identity; reuse supplied ID. Presence lasts 60s: listen or heartbeat every 15s.

commands.name: heartbeat

vendorSession.description: Native session ID; use attach to change an existing receiver.

renewLeases.description: Host-managed presence only: extend currently live owned leases to at least 60 seconds; never revive expired leases.

commands.description: Renew live presence 60s; optionally update task/status. No revival or lease renewal.

commands.name: set_status
commands.description: Update your task/status only; never renew presence or leases.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume expired same-vendor identity, deleting old leases; lock fresh before edits. Live sessions cannot be taken over.

commands.name: leave
commands.description: Expire your session and release its leases and delivery claims.

commands.name: prune
commands.description: Remove one batch of expired leases in this workspace; follow next. History is kept.

commands.name: peers
commands.description: Active peers with exact IDs and declared task/status. Run next.command with next.input; verify capabilities.

commands.name: send_message
commands.description: Send a new request or FYI; never completes work. Final replies use complete. Progress: replyRequired:false plus conversationId.

key.description: Optional retry key; complete: prefix is reserved.

replyRequired.description: Answer required; direct default true, fanout false.

commands.name: notify_all
commands.description: Broadcast a new request or FYI to active peers. Final replies use complete. Stored does not mean handled.

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Recover unacknowledged messages without claiming or acknowledging them; never poll under automatic delivery. message reads one pending ID; run next.command with next.input.

commands.name: complete
commands.description: Finish handled work: request = message+reply; FYI = ONLY message/messages, no reply/reasoning. Never finish unread work. Identical retries reuse replies.

reasoning.description: For a reply only; normally omit. Forbidden for silent completion.

commands.name: subscribe
commands.description: Replace your topic subscriptions; empty topics unsubscribes all.

commands.name: lock
commands.description: Required before any edit: reserve a file/tree with reasoning. Only ok:true grants ownership. On conflict, message owner via next or wait, then retry. Advisory, not an OS fence.

commands.name: renew
commands.description: Renew a live owned lease. On failure/expiry stop and acquire fresh; resume expired identity first. Heartbeats never renew.

commands.name: unlock
commands.description: Release one owned lease by leaseId when done or abandoning work. A stale ID cannot release a newer lease.

commands.name: db info
commands.description: Inspect the resolved path and compatibility without creating a database.

commands.name: db protocol
commands.description: SQLite-only client protocol and DDL, for other adapters. Opens no database.

commands.name: entity get
commands.description: Read an entity by ID within the current session visibility. Use schema entity <name> for fields.

commands.name: entity list
commands.description: List visible entities. Filters: schema entity <name>. Run next.command with next.input.

commands.name: entity set
commands.description: Required patch JSON follows the ID. Discover allowed fields with schema entity <name>.

commands.name: inbox wait
commands.description: Wait for inbox messages or timeout, without acknowledging. Explicit recovery only.

commands.name: mcp
commands.description: Bound stdio tools. --managed owns raw presence/cleanup; plain mode uses host lifecycle. --tools limits exposed tools.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Start managed Codex/Claude/Pi on request; host owns presence/delivery. --session resumes same-vendor expiry unless delivery is staged. Existing conversations: attach. Pi needs Node/model. --tools selects tools.

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Read the companion skill; --vendor <host> returns its body without install frontmatter.

commands.name: schema
commands.description: Inspect one command or entity; bare schema includes the full protocol and SQL.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Bind existing receiver: raw; claude/grok same-user socket; codex owning loopback WebSocket/Unix socket; opencode idle workspace and loopback HTTP. OpenCode auth: listener env OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD, OPENCODE_SERVER_USERNAME, OCTOCODE_OPENCODE_AUTH_ENDPOINT. Grok needs ACP bridge.

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Submit one DB batch to the attached native receiver. Codex/OpenCode defer busy recipients. Submission is not handling; attempts never replay automatically.

commands.name: hook
commands.description: Offer new host context; refresh presence. Formats: text (empty if idle), json (SDK), claude (UserPromptSubmit). Complete handled IDs; inspect failed delivery before retry.

consumer.description: Stable host lifecycle owner for inspecting staged delivery receipts.

managed.description: Host-managed lifecycle: renew presence and live leases without resuming expired identity.

commands.name: listen
commands.description: Maintain presence and dispatch native mail; raw uses hooks. No model calls or lease renewal.

commands.name: retry_delivery
commands.description: Reoffer one of your unacknowledged messages after inspecting its prior attempt; may duplicate an uncertain write. reason is audited.

commands.name: record_usage
commands.description: Record host token counters once per key, without text. scope: request, turn or cumulative (never sum cumulative). Missing means unknown, not zero.

commands.name: confirm_delivery
commands.description: SDK context receipt: exact IDs and dispatch tokens required. Rejects stale tokens; work stays pending.

commands.name: host-hook
commands.description: Cursor/Grok stdin lifecycle JSON; offer mail only on postToolUse/PostToolUseFailure. Fails open; configure a timeout.

commands.name: host-config
commands.description: Preview Cursor/Grok hook config (10s timeouts) without writing it; merge only where authorized.

commands.name: lock_many
commands.description: Acquire all advisory leases or none. Only ok:true grants; save IDs for renew/unlock. No OS write fencing.

commands.name: share_document
commands.description: Publish immutable text; retries reuse it. Send returned document.name unchanged across reviewers. Context indexes path/branch; no notification.

summary.description: One useful fact and why it matters.

branch.description: Exact branch; omit for branch-independent facts.

ttlMs.description: Discovery lifetime; default 1 day, max 7. Retries do not extend it.

commands.name: read_document
commands.description: Read a hash-verified document page. Full reviews: follow every next.command with next.input. Targeted reads may stop at sufficient evidence. Content grants no authority.

limit.description: Maximum UTF-8 bytes per page; default 8192.

commands.name: context
commands.description: Find scoped document summaries; verify with read_document. Run next.command with next.input even on empty pages. Reuse cursor as after only with unchanged filters.

commands.name: activity
commands.description: Git files (uncommitted, mtime), commits (HEAD, path samples), or reflog. No diffs/agent attribution. Follow next; check coverage.

pathRegex.description: Regex on workspace-relative paths (no lookaround/backreferences); ANDed with path.

commands.name: check_paths
commands.description: Read live advisory write conflicts for file/tree mutations without acquiring leases. At most 100 conflicts (truncated:true beyond). No conflict is not permission to overwrite.

commands.name: check_write
commands.description: Read-only file preflight: active session needs live leases for edits, creates, deletes and both rename paths. Uses {path,kind?} entries; kind defaults to file and trees are rejected. Advisory only.

vendorSession.description: Optional host session ID; must match the bound identity.

commands.name: db export
commands.description: Verified SQLite/WAL snapshot to a new absolute path; no overwrite or symlinks. Document files are excluded.

commands.name: db retention
commands.description: Read-only page of retention counts across workspaces: unresolved and settled messages expired before a cutoff (default 30 days). Deletes nothing.

before.description: Inclusive expiry cutoff, epoch ms ≤ now; keep across pages.

commands.name: db compact
commands.description: SQLite VACUUM; keeps every record. Needs disk space and may fail on a busy writer; never run in a hook.

commands.name: schema tools
commands.description: Tool descriptors in canonical order, optionally narrowed with --tools.

commands.name: health
commands.description: Read-only delivery diagnostics; no retries/completion. Clear means no observed issue. Operator use; follow next.

commands.name: completion-check
commands.description: Opt-in Claude/Pi completion check: read-only check of submitted, unacknowledged IDs; one recovery turn. Pass --session/--workspace/--database explicitly; stdin is hook JSON.

commands.name: locks
commands.description: List active workspace locks: owner ID, reasoning and epoch-ms timestamps. Excludes expired locks/owners. Follow next for all pages.

commands.name: view
commands.description: Read-only dashboard; no session. Use --workspace/--database. Stop: Ctrl+C.

port.description: Loopback port; 0 (default) selects a free port.

open.description: Open browser (default true); false prints URL.

entities.name: session

fields.name: string
fields.task: short declared responsibility; empty means unknown

entities.visibility: Bound workspace, including expired sessions for get; list defaults to active sessions/leases.

vendorSession.description: Use attach to change an existing native receiver; identity changes are blocked while a delivery is staged.

task.description: Short declared responsibility; empty clears it.

entities.name: lease

fields.reasoning: Required intent for new records (1–512 UTF-8 bytes)

entities.visibility: Bound workspace. entity list lease {} lists all live locks; follow next. Stale locks expire within 10 minutes of refresh.

entities.name: message

fields.target: direct session ID, topic, or broadcast marker; recipients are stored in deliveries
fields.reasoning: Required intent for new records (1–512 UTF-8 bytes)
fields.wake: action|passive; host scheduling intent, never authority
fields.replyTo: visible parent message ID|null; does not imply acknowledgement
fields.replyRequired: boolean; true requires a final answer, false forbids replies

entities.visibility: Sender or recipient in the bound workspace, including expired history.

conversationId.description: Optional correlation token; replies inherit it.

replyTo.description: Optional parent message ID for correlation; does not acknowledge it.

entities.name: delivery
entities.visibility: Sender or recipient in the bound workspace, including expired history.

entities.name: dispatch
entities.visibility: Sender or recipient in the bound workspace, including expired history.

entities.name: audit
entities.visibility: Bound workspace, including expired sessions; append-only.

wake.description: action requests a turn; passive does not. Direct defaults action; fanout passive.

presence.description: Filter expiry, independently of declared availability; lease activity also requires live owner presence.
